prompt: Poll all feeds and give me the raw JSON output, don't summarize it.
expected_output: Strict JSON following the skill's contract: count, results with per-category clusters (cluster_id, score, matched_keywords, other_sources, items), errors array

assertions.name: top_level_fields
assertions.description: Output must contain the top-level contract fields: count, results, errors
assertions.check: output contains '"count"' AND output contains '"results"' AND output contains '"errors"'

assertions.name: cluster_fields
assertions.description: Output must contain cluster-level fields: clusters, matched_keywords, other_sources
assertions.check: output contains '"clusters"' AND output contains '"matched_keywords"' AND output contains '"other_sources"'

assertions.name: item_and_score_fields
assertions.description: Output must contain item-level fields: feed_id, score, cluster_size
assertions.check: output contains '"feed_id"' AND output contains '"score"' AND output contains '"cluster_size"'

assertions.name: timestamp_field
assertions.description: Output must contain the polled_at timestamp field

assertions.name: no_crash_output
assertions.description: Output must not contain a Python traceback
